Class SbxSandboxTransfer

java.lang.Object
com.mobybank.harness.infrastructure.sbx.SbxSandboxTransfer
All Implemented Interfaces:
SandboxTransfer
public final class SbxSandboxTransfer extends Object implements SandboxTransfer
Moves a session with sbx move, which captures the whole sandbox filesystem as an image and starts a new sandbox from it at the destination. The conversation files, the agent's own history and everything it installed travel with it, so the next turn can carry on where the last one stopped.

Each move asks for the next generation's name (harness-<session>-g<n>); the service may add a suffix, so the new sandbox is found afterwards by listing the destination. A session that has not started a sandbox yet has nothing to transfer: it simply starts at the destination on its next turn.
